soccer:544814.body: Kadioglu (hip) remains unavailable and has not travelled to Spain for Thursday's Conference League match at Getafe, though coach Fabian Hurzeler is hopeful he could be ready for Sunday's game against Brentford. "We left no one at home for a rest, but a few players had to stay home because they're not available for tomorrow, so Ferdy won't be available. Regarding Ferdy, we still have a big hope that he might be ready for Sunday.
soccer:544814.head: Out Thursday, hopeful for Sunday

soccer:544815.body: Struijk (undisclosed) has not travelled for Thursday's Conference League match at Getafe will be assessed day by day, according to head coach Fabian Hurzeler . "With Pascal Struijk, we have to go day by day."
soccer:544815.head: Considered day by day

soccer:544817.body: Emerson (knee) has been ruled out of Thursday's Europa League match at Bayer Leverkusen, according to coach Bruno Genesio, per Le Phoceen . "He won't be fit for tomorrow's match; we've decided not to take any risks. We'll have to wait until Friday or Saturday to find out more."
soccer:544817.head: Ruled out Thursday

soccer:544821.body: Simons (knee) will enter the final phase of his recovery later this month, which includes returning to team training, and is ahead of schedule to rejoin the squad around seven months after his ACL injury, per Tom Allnutt of The Times .
soccer:544821.head: Ahead of schedule in ACL recovery

soccer:544827.body: Harit won't play in Thursday's Europa League match at Bayer Leverkusen because of a recovery issue but should be available for Sunday's game at Lens, according to manager Bruno Genesio, per Le Phoceen ."For Amine, it's more of a recovery problem. He should be there on Sunday."
soccer:544827.head: Out Thursday, expected back for Lens

soccer:544830.body: Hlozek will miss Thursday's Europa League clash against Crystal Palace due to muscular issue, with Hoffenheim manager Christian Ilzer confirming his absence ahead of the match. " Adam Hlozek is out with muscular problems.
soccer:544830.head: Ruled out against Crystal Palace

soccer:544832.body: Simic was forced off with an injury in the 33rd minute of Wednesday's Champions League match against Viking.
soccer:544832.head: Forced off against Viking

soccer:544836.body: Virgili was taken off with a possible injury in the 36th minute of Wednesday's Champions League match against PSV Eindhoven and was replaced by Felix Lemarechal , according to Sporza .
soccer:544836.head: Taken off early against PSV

soccer:544839.body: Guirassy was forced off with a thigh injury during Wednesday's Champions League win over Real Betis, and although the problem is not believed to be serious, he remains doubtful for Saturday's clash with SV Elversberg and might not be risked, according to head coach Niko Kovac , per Sport1 . "We have to see whether it's more than a strain, which I don't believe. We didn't want to take any risks. If he can't play against Elversberg on Saturday, then we at least hope he'll be available again after the international break."
soccer:544839.head: Forced off with thigh injury

soccer:544840.body: Koita scored one goal and assisted once from three shots and one chance created in Wednesday's 3-2 defeat to Real Madrid. He was sent off with a straight red card in the 95th minute.
soccer:544840.head: Suspension Clouds Outlook

soccer:544841.body: Coufal (thigh) won't play in Thursday's Europa League match at Crystal Palace and remains doubtful for Sunday's home game against Schalke, according to coach Christian Ilzer,"So Vlad (Coufal) is still out"
soccer:544841.head: Still unavailable for Thursday

soccer:544843.body: McCarthy was sent off with a straight red card in the 77th minute of Wednesday's Champions League match against Viking for serious foul play and will be suspended for at least one UCL match.
soccer:544843.head: Sent off against Viking

soccer:544845.body: Marin conceded a penalty and received a straight red card for a last-man foul in the 88th minute of Wednesday's Champions League defeat to Porto. He will consequently miss the next UCL match against Manchester City through suspension.
soccer:544845.head: Sent off against Porto

soccer:544848.body: Osterhage has been left out of the squad for Thursday's Conference League match at Trabzonspor due to a muscle problem, according to the club .
soccer:544848.head: Left out with muscle issue

soccer:544850.body: Romero (quadriceps) rejoined team training Wednesday after a setback in his recovery, but his availability for Thursday's Conference League match against Brighton remains unconfirmed, according to manager Jose Bordalas, per InfoBae . "We'll see in the end whether we can count on him."
soccer:544850.head: Could return against Brighton

soccer:544851.body: Badwal (hamstring) could be available for Saturday's regular-season finale against CF Montreal, according to coach Jesper Sorensen, per Har Journalist .
soccer:544851.head: Could return Saturday

soccer:544852.body: Dina Ebimbe was forced to leave Wednesday's training session early due to right thigh problems, with the severity of the muscle injury yet to be determined, according to Ruhr Nachrichten .
soccer:544852.head: Picks up thigh problem

soccer:544853.body: Pieringer completed several fitness tests Wednesday after spraining his right foot against Borussia Monchengladbach and could return to team training Thursday and be available for Saturday's game Eintracht Frankfurt, according to Neue Westfalische .
soccer:544853.head: Set to resume training Thursday

soccer:544854.body: Konsa left Wednesday's 2-1 win over Slavia Prague in UCL action after experiencing a discomfort, and he was mentioned by coach Mikel Arteta, who said "He's played a lot, so many games in the last few weeks, and he had some issues and we decided to take him off."
soccer:544854.head: Exits UCL game with issue

soccer:544863.body: Zendejas (adductor) is aiming to be available for the week 16 derby against Pumas, per Julio Ibanez of TUDN .
soccer:544863.head: Could reappear against Pumas

soccer:544864.body: Rodriguez (strain) won't be rushed back to action as the club wants to avoid the risk of a more serious injury, per Julio Ibanez of TUDN .
soccer:544864.head: Return will be handled cautiously

soccer:544865.body: Zaldivar's participation in upcoming matches is at risk as he deals with a bruised leg, according to reporter Alberto Avalos .
soccer:544865.head: Questionable with leg contusion

soccer:544869.body: Montiel (thigh) has been fully involved in practice and is expected to bounce back Saturday against Pachuca, per reporter Alberto Avalos .
soccer:544869.head: Recovered from injury

soccer:544874.body: Cubas (ankle) is not expected to return to the field yet, with manager Jesper Sorensen stating Wednesday "I don't think Andres and Emmanuel will be ready."
soccer:544874.head: Unlikely for Decision Day

soccer:544875.body: Sabbi (ankle) may not play in the final regular-season clash against Montreal, ahead of which manager Jesper Sorensen commented "I don't think Andres and Emmanuel will be ready."
soccer:544875.head: Another absence expected

soccer:544876.body: Jurado will be sidelined for the next 3-4 months following surgery to repair a stress microfracture in his right tibia, the club reported Tuesday.
soccer:544876.head: Ruled out 3-4 months

soccer:544878.body: Calderon (undisclosed) remains questionable as he's yet to rejoin full work with the squad heading into the penultimate Apertura regular-season week, David Torrijos of Record reports.
soccer:544878.head: Not training with team

soccer:544879.body: Macias (knee) is taking small steps in his reintegration into the team, so it's unlikely that he'll see any action in the derby against America, potentially pushing his return until after the international break, per David Torrijos of Record .
soccer:544879.head: Could return after break

soccer:544888.body: Klaas (hamstring) has been racking up minutes of play for Paderborn's Under-21 side, scoring a goal in his last appearance on Oct. 10, with coach Ralf Kettemann saying "It was important that Sese could play and scored. That does him good," per Frank Beineke of Neue Westfalenische .
soccer:544888.head: Playing with U21 squad

soccer:544889.body: Kounde (ankle) returned to limited practice apart from the group during Wednesday's training session and has only a slim chance of featuring Sunday against Atletico, Ferran Correas of Sport reports.
soccer:544889.head: Training on sidelines Wednesday

soccer:544890.body: Casado (collarbone) rejoined team drills in recent weeks and already worked normally in Tuesday's practice, Anton Lopez of Riazor.org reports.
soccer:544890.head: Training ahead of schedule

soccer:544893.body: Lepaul is expected to resume training Thursday or Friday as he continues recovering from an ankle sprain, although his availability for Sunday's Ligue 1 clash against Lille remains highly doubtful, according to Ouest France .
soccer:544893.head: Could resume training soon

soccer:544894.body: Azeez (fitness) has been ruled out for Thursday's Conference League clash against Getafe after being left out of Brighton's traveling squad, although he is making progress toward full fitness, according to coach Fabian Hurzeler . "We left no one at home for a rest, but a few players had to stay home because they're not available for tomorrow. Femi is still not available. They're getting closer, especially Femi."
soccer:544894.head: Getting closer to return

soccer:544895.body: Lukic (groin) is expected to return to full team training this week and should be available for Sunday's Premier League clash against Bournemouth after missing Ipswich's last three matches, according to coach Gary O'Neil, per Stuart Wilson of East Anglian. "He'll join the group on Monday, full training, and it gives him a full run up into Bournemouth. He probably hasn't done quite enough with the group to have put him back in. But he is feeling good. He worked really hard on the grass yesterday. I received a message a while ago saying he had a good day again on the grass today. I am aware that
soccer:544895.head: Expected back against Bournemouth

soccer:544922.body: Nusa was substituted as a precaution during Wednesday's 3-2 Champions League defeat against Manchester City after experiencing muscular discomfort, leaving his availability for Saturday's Bundesliga clash against Augsburg uncertain, according to coach Martin Demichelis . "He was close to getting injured. If I hadn't taken him off, we would have lost him for six weeks, that was obvious."
soccer:544922.head: Dealing with muscular discomfort

soccer:544940.body: Kochorashvili (personal) missed Thursday's team training session with Sevilla's permission to attend the funeral of former Castellon teammate Jesus de Miguel, leaving his availability for Friday's La Liga clash against Alaves uncertain, according to Zona Mixta .
soccer:544940.head: Misses training for personal reasons

soccer:544943.body: Karazor (muscular) remains doubtful for Saturday's Bundesliga clash against Werder Bremen after an MRI ruled out structural damage but revealed internal bleeding from a muscle contusion, according to coach Sebastian Hoeness . "Ata could be another absentee. Nothing is final yet, so we'll have to assess his condition day by day."
soccer:544943.head: Remains doubtful for Bremen clash

soccer:544944.body: Promel (undisclosed) is expected to be available for Saturday's Bundesliga clash against Werder Bremen despite undergoing medical examinations Wednesday due to minor physical discomfort, according to coach Sebastian Hoeness . "Grischa was also examined yesterday because of some minor issues. We expect him to be available."
soccer:544944.head: Expected available against Bremen

soccer:544945.body: Barrios (ankle) trained fully Thursday alongside the starters from Tuesday's Champions League clash against Bayern Munich and should be available for Sunday's La Liga encounter against Barcelona, according to Pascual Ruiz Arnal of Marca.
soccer:544945.head: Returns to full training

soccer:544946.body: Cardoso (thigh) trained at a good pace Thursday alongside the substitutes from Tuesday's Champions League clash against Bayern Munich, raising hopes that he could return for Sunday's La Liga encounter against Barcelona, according to Pascual Ruiz Arnal of Marca.
soccer:544946.head: Making progress in team training

soccer:544948.body: Quenda (muscular) is doubtful for Sunday's Premier League clash against Sunderland after missing Wednesday's training session and being ruled out of Thursday's preparations, although he is expected to return to training Friday, according to Bobby Vincent of Football London.
soccer:544948.head: Doubtful for Sunderland clash

soccer:544949.body: Ndiaye (abdomen) completed another individual running session Thursday as he continues recovering from an appendectomy performed in October, according to the club .
soccer:544949.head: Returns to individual training

soccer:544952.body: Romero (quadriceps) remains unavailable for Thursday's Conference League clash against Brighton despite returning to team training Wednesday following a setback in his recovery, the club posted .
soccer:544952.head: Remains sidelined

soccer:544957.body: Morita (muscle) is expected to remain sidelined for several weeks after suffering another injury to the same muscle in the same leg as his previous setback, according to coach Sergej Jakirovic, per BBC Humberside Sport . "He'll be back in a few weeks."
soccer:544957.head: Out for several weeks

soccer:544958.body: Rodon (hamstring) has returned to full team training ahead of Saturday's Premier League clash against Tottenham after spending several weeks on the sidelines, according to coach Daniel Farke . "The good news is that Joe Rodon is back in full team training."
soccer:544958.head: Could return to squad Saturday

soccer:544959.body: Calvert-Lewin (foot) is doubtful for Saturday's Premier League clash against Tottenham after missing Thursday's team training session, according to coach Daniel Farke . "Calvert-Lewin wasn't able to train with us today, but I'm carefully optimistic about him."
soccer:544959.head: Optimism despite foot concern

soccer:544960.body: Okafor (groin) has yet to participate in team training this week and remains limited to individual work ahead of Saturday's Premier League clash against Tottenham, according to coach Daniel Farke . "Okafor is still in individual training."
soccer:544960.head: Remains limited to individual training

soccer:544961.body: Stach (foot) remains doubtful for Saturday's Premier League clash against Tottenham after being restricted to individual training throughout the week, according to coach Daniel Farke . "Stach is also another doubt."
soccer:544961.head: Doubtful for Saturday

soccer:544962.body: Grealish will remain unavailable for Friday's Premier League clash against Coventry City, according to coach David Moyes . "Jack is not available for tomorrow. I wouldn't give you the plan, but we will be working with Jack again soon."
soccer:544962.head: Ruled out against Coventry

soccer:544963.body: Branthwaite (cramp) is expected to be available for Friday's Premier League clash against Coventry City despite being carefully managed following his early exit against Newcastle, according to coach David Moyes. "Yeah, we're just nursing [Branthwaite] along a wee bit, just checking to see he's okay, so we need to see how he is, yes."
soccer:544963.head: Expected to be available Friday

soccer:544964.body: Scamacca (thigh) has been called up for Thursday's UEFA Conference League match against Kairat Almaty.
soccer:544964.head: Recovers from injury

soccer:544965.head: Sustains thigh strain

soccer:544966.body: Jesus (calf) has trained throughout the week ahead of Saturday's Premier League clash against Manchester City, according to coach Oliver Glasner . "Igor has trained all week and has looked good."
soccer:544966.head: Could feature Saturday

soccer:544967.body: Bayo (thigh) has been spotted in training this week and is a late call for Friday's clash with Venezia, DiarioFVG reported.
soccer:544967.head: Could return against Venezia

soccer:544968.body: Dominguez (muscle) has suffered a setback in his recovery and is expected to remain sidelined for approximately eight weeks, according to coach Oliver Glasner . "Dominguez has had a setback and will be out for around eight weeks now."
soccer:544968.head: Ruled out for eight weeks

soccer:544969.body: Zanoli (thigh) won't return against Venezia on Friday, Tuttomercatoweb reported.
soccer:544969.head: Out for Venezia match

soccer:544970.body: Savona (knee) has returned to team training but will remain unavailable for Saturday's Premier League clash against Manchester City, according to coach Oliver Glasner . "Savona joined team training today. We had to manage his workload, but it looks like he will play over the international break."
soccer:544970.head: Could return during international break

soccer:544971.body: Milambo remains unavailable for Sunday's Premier League clash against Brighton despite training consistently over the past 10 days, according to coach Keith Andrews . "Probably not just yet. He's trained pretty consistently over the last week, 10 days, and did a really tough session today."
soccer:544971.head: Still not ready to return

soccer:544972.body: Dasilva (hamstring) is making progress in his recovery but is not yet ready for a first-team return ahead of Sunday's Premier League clash against Brighton, according to coach Keith Andrews . "Josh is a little bit closer, but we'll look to build him more and more as the weeks go on."
soccer:544972.head: Closing in on first-team return

soccer:544975.body: Joelinton (muscle) is set to miss Saturday's Premier League clash against Fulham after suffering another injury, with Newcastle still assessing the severity of the issue, according to coach Matthias Jaissle . "Joey went out with an injury again, we need to make the final treatment plan for him and see how long he will be out."
soccer:544975.head: Facing spell on sidelines

soccer:544976.body: Miley (hamstring) is making encouraging progress in his recovery ahead of Saturday's Premier League clash against Fulham, according to coach Matthias Jaissle . "Lewis is getting better and better, showed a good reaction, he is making progress how I expected and wished for."
soccer:544976.head: Could return Saturday

soccer:544977.body: Fernandez-Pardo (illness) has resumed team training after being sidelined for more than two weeks with a severe virus, although his availability for Saturday's Premier League clash against Fulham remains uncertain, according to coach Matthias Jaissle . "Matias has had a heavy virus, he has been out for more than two weeks. He is progressing and training again with us, we will have to see how he is physically before Fulham."
soccer:544977.head: Late call for Saturday

soccer:544979.body: Tuanzebe (adductor) is dealing with a minor injury concern ahead of Saturday's Ligue 1 clash against Paris FC, according to coach Will Still . "Axel is experiencing some adductor discomfort."
soccer:544979.head: Uncertain for Paris FC clash

soccer:544987.body: Koch (knee) is doubtful for Saturday's Bundesliga clash against Paderborn after suffering a knock to his knee and being limited to partial team training Thursday, according to coach Adi Hutter . "Robin took a knock to his knee. He trained partially today, but I think it will be a race against time. I hope he will be ready, but he might not make it."
soccer:544987.head: Late call against Paderborn

soccer:544988.body: Gotze (ear infection) is expected to miss Saturday's Bundesliga clash against Paderborn after being unable to participate in team training this week, according to coach Adi Hutter . "Mario is struggling with an ear infection and will probably stay at home at his own request."
soccer:544988.head: Dealing with ear infection

soccer:544990.body: Hagglund (concussion) has been ruled out for Saturday's regular-season finale against Nashville SC after developing concussion-like symptoms two days after taking a blow to the head against Philadelphia, according to coach Pat Noonan, per Laurel Pfahler .
soccer:544990.head: Out for regular-season finale

soccer:544991.body: Malacia (ankle) remains day-to-day ahead of Saturday's regular-season finale against Nashville SC as he continues recovering from injury, according to coach Pat Noonan, per Laurel Pfahler .
soccer:544991.head: Fitness remains uncertain

soccer:544992.body: Malatini (thigh) remains unavailable for Saturday's regular-season finale against Nashville SC as he continues recovering from injury, according to coach pat Noonan, per Cincy Soccer Talk .
soccer:544992.head: Remains unavailable

soccer:544993.head: Available for Udinese bout

soccer:544994.head: Remains sidelined

soccer:544995.body: Hashioka (undisclosed) remains doubtful for Friday's Bundesliga clash against Hamburger SV after being limited to individual training earlier this week, according to coach Alexander Blessin .
soccer:544995.head: Doubtful against Hamburger SV

soccer:544996.body: Kleindienst (thigh) remains unavailable for Friday's Bundesliga clash against Hamburger SV but is expected to return after the international break as he continues making progress in his recovery, according to coach Alexander Blessin . "Tim is making good progress, and I think we can expect him back after the international break."
soccer:544996.head: Targets return after break

soccer:545000.head: Unlikely to return Saturday

soccer:545001.body: Rogers (undisclosed) has yet to return to team training ahead of Saturday's regular-season finale against Columbus Crew, leaving him unlikely to feature in the encounter, according to Joe Chatz .
soccer:545001.head: Still absent from training

soccer:545002.body: Ream (Achilles) will remain unavailable for Saturday's regular-season finale against Inter Miami as he continues recovering from injury, according to coach Dean Smith, per Will Palaszczuk .
soccer:545002.head: Ruled out against Inter Miami

soccer:545004.body: Darvich (hamstring) remains doubtful for Saturday's Bundesliga clash against Borussia Dortmund as Elversberg continue monitoring the fitness of their injured players, according to coach Vincent Wagner . "We will handle the situation carefully in the players' best interests. I hope we will have the entire squad available after the international break at the latest."
soccer:545004.head: Remains uncertain for Saturday

soccer:545005.body: Gyamerah (thigh) remains doubtful for Saturday's Bundesliga clash against Borussia Dortmund as Elversberg continue assessing whether he has recovered sufficiently from injury, according to coach Vincent Wagner . "We will handle the situation carefully in the players' best interests. I hope we will have the entire squad available after the international break at the latest."
soccer:545005.head: Doubtful against Dortmund

soccer:545026.body: Sarr (groin) won't be an option for Senegal, according to manager Patrick Viera.
soccer:545026.head: Not playing with Senegal

soccer:545042.body: Pineda was in the gym but didn't train with the squad Thursday, Joe Chatz of On Tap Sports reports.
soccer:545042.head: Works in gym Thursday

soccer:545047.head: Set to travel with team

soccer:546728.body: Barrenetxea (hamstring) underwent successful surgery Friday to address a severe right hamstring injury, with the procedure completed without complications, according to the club .
soccer:546728.head: Undergoes successful hamstring surgery

soccer:546730.body: Cleary (illness) has resumed non-contact training after dealing with mononucleosis and is expected to return to full training next week, according to coach Dean Smith, per Will Palaszczuk .
soccer:546730.head: Progresses to non-contact training

soccer:546731.body: Ream (Achilles) participated in training throughout the week but continues to experience some soreness, according to coach Dean Smith, per Will Palaszczuk .
soccer:546731.head: Trains despite Achilles soreness

soccer:546735.body: Lookman was forced off with an undisclosed injury during the first half of Nigeria's World Cup qualifier against Tanzania on Friday, according to Nacho Donado of Club Uria.
soccer:546735.head: Exits early against Tanzania

soccer:546747.body: Lod returned to Chicago Fire team training after missing the club's last nine matches, according to Joe Chatz .
soccer:546747.head: Returns to team training

soccer:546748.body: Rogers was back in team training ahead of Chicago Fire's Nov. 22 playoff clash against Charlotte, according to Joe Chatz .
soccer:546748.head: Resumes team training

soccer:546762.body: Mbappe (hamstring) is expected to be an option for Sunday's Nations League match against Turkey, according to Damien Degorre of L'Equipe.
soccer:546762.head: Expected to play Sunday

soccer:546770.body: Ouedraogo (shoulder) has begun individual training around two months after his surgery, though the club does not expect him to rejoin team training before January, per RB Live .
soccer:546770.head: Begins individual training

soccer:546773.body: Ake suffered a soleus injury in his right calf during an individual training session as part of his recovery from a previous adductor problem and is expected to be out for three to four weeks, according to Yagiz Sabuncuoglu .
soccer:546773.head: Suffers calf setback in rehab

soccer:546785.body: Yamal (knee) trained with Spain on Friday after recovering from discomfort.
soccer:546785.head: Rejoins Spain training as expected

soccer:546793.body: Dorgu was sent back to his club following medical assessment, with Denmark national team doctor Morten Boesen saying "We have conducted a series of tests on Dorgu, and he did not perform at a sufficient level to be ready to play the two matches. He requires further recovery following his injury, so we are sending him home for continued rehabilitation."
soccer:546793.head: Withdraws from national team

soccer:546808.body: Davies exited Canada's CONCACAF Nations League match against Guatemala after less than five minutes with a muscle injury, per Canadian Soccer Daily .
soccer:546808.head: Subs off early with national team
